prompt.name: Authoritative REU Validation
prompt.description: Research current NSF REU opportunities in AI and machine learning for undergraduates, identify the strongest currently relevant official opportunities, verify deadlines and eligibility from authoritative sources, and produce a concise actionable shortlist with uncertainty clearly labeled where needed.

subtasks.description: Identify Relevant NSF REU Programs – Broad Discovery
subtasks.success_criteria: Generate a list of at least 10 NSF REU programs in AI and machine learning for undergraduates active in 2024. Document the program name, institution, principal investigator (PI), and a brief description of the research focus.

subtasks.description: Verify Deadlines and Eligibility Criteria – Authoritative Verification
subtasks.success_criteria: For each identified REU program, determine the application deadline and confirm eligibility requirements (e.g., major, GPA, degree level) directly from the official NSF REU website or the program’s website. Record the deadline and eligibility details for each program.

subtasks.description: Verify candidate opportunities and program requirements directly from official NSF and university program sources.
subtasks.success_criteria: Confirm which opportunities are real, current, and relevant by checking official program pages for deadlines, eligibility, and research focus.

subtasks.description: Broaden lead discovery across multiple authoritative program sources instead of focusing on a single incidental page.
subtasks.success_criteria: Identify multiple distinct opportunities or program leads from official program pages, .gov, .edu, or primary organization sources, and note which leads warrant deeper verification.
